# anthropic_plugin_installation_setting (Resource)

Beta. Manages an organization-owned plugin's installation setting for the whole organization or for one RBAC Group (`/v1/organizations/plugins/{plugin_id}/installation_settings/{target}`). Available to Claude Enterprise organizations only.

Destroying an `organization` setting returns the plugin to its marketplace default. Destroying a group setting makes its members fall back to the organization-wide setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Organization-wide setting for one plugin
resource "anthropic_plugin_installation_setting" "org" {
  plugin_id               = "plugin_01EXAMPLE"
  target                  = "organization"
  installation_preference = "available"
}

# Setting for one RBAC Group, which overrides the organization-wide setting for its members
resource "anthropic_plugin_installation_setting" "engineering" {
  plugin_id               = "plugin_01EXAMPLE"
  target                  = "grp_01EXAMPLE"
  installation_preference = "required"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `installation_preference` (String) `required`, `auto_install`, `available` or `not_available`.
- `plugin_id` (String) ID of an organization-owned plugin (`plugin_...`).
- `target` (String) `organization` for the organization-wide setting, or an RBAC Group ID for that group's setting.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the target was first given a setting for this plugin.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `<plugin_id>/<target>`.
- `target_type` (String) `organization` or `rbac_group`, as returned by the API.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the setting last changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <plugin_id>/<target>, where target is "organization" or an RBAC Group ID
terraform import anthropic_plugin_installation_setting.org plugin_01EXAMPLE/organization
```
